description: This PHP file defines a subpanel view for the EmailMarketing module in a SuiteCRM-related project. It initializes UI components such as buttons and a list view, and renders a subpanel interface for managing email marketing campaigns related to a focus record.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM front end.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template object with a specified template file and language string array.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables or images to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text or HTML content for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data.
